description: Pass/fail thresholds for tools/bench/gate.ps1. Derived from the display refresh period and what smooth zoom requires, not from the baseline. Thresholds in ms assume the measured period; '_periods' metrics are refresh-rate independent. Rationale for each: docs/03_Technical_Architecture.md section 7.4.

criteria.why: Bench ran to the end (no watchdog/quit).
Without UIAccess MagSetFullscreenTransform fails silently (R-12); numbers would be meaningless.
Every transform update must land (R-12, AC-ERR.04).
Telemetry buffer must not overflow (bench validity).
Smooth motion needs a new zoom value on every refresh while a gesture is in progress; 1% allows scheduler noise only (AC-2.2.02, AC-2.2.03).
DWM composes once per refresh; a second update in one refresh means the first is never shown, so the motion is uneven.
During a gesture, consecutive updates are one refresh apart; 10% tolerance for DwmFlush wake jitter.
No gap of two or more refreshes inside a gesture: that is a visible hitch.
No render-loop tick later than 1.5 periods (render-loop invariant 4, AC-2.3.10).
MagSetFullscreenTransform must stay a small fraction of the 16.7 ms frame budget (render-loop.md: per-frame tick < 0.1 ms target; 2 ms ceiling).
The first zoom after launch must also render on the next frame (AC-2.2.01); a cold-start stall longer than one period is a visible freeze.
AC-2.2.01: rendered on the very next display frame, so input to transform update is at most one period (+0.3 ms timer slack).
Update issued within one period then shown at the following vblank: at most two periods input-to-photon (R-03 tolerable bound).
After the last input the zoom must come to rest without perceptible catch-up (AC-2.2.03, AC-2.4.08); 100 ms is below the 100-150 ms animation band of AC-2.2.04.
The desktop point under a stationary pointer must not move while zooming (AC-2.1.09-11); sub-pixel error keeps it visually fixed.
A jump of more than one physical pixel at the anchor is visible as shimmer.
Scrolling in and back out by the same amount inside the free zoom band must return to the same zoom (AC-2.1.06; R-17 drift).
